source: That result is evidence about optimization behavior, not a universal statement that Pre-LN is always better. Later architectures have revisited normalization and residual scaling in different ways. DeepNorm, for example, modifies residual connections and initialization to stabilize very deep Transformers. [21]
zh: 该结果是优化行为的证据，而不是预逻辑网络总是更好的普遍说法。后来的架构以不同的方式重新审视了归一化和残差缩放。例如，DeepNorm 修改残差连接和初始化以稳定非常深的 Transformer。 [21]
